domain: Video Game Review and Rating Aggregation
scenario:
A global video game analytics company is developing an enterprise-level platform to aggregate, analyze, and distribute video game reviews and ratings from various online sources. This platform will collect reviews from multiple sites and platforms such as Steam, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation. The goal is to provide comprehensive insights into the gaming industry, helping game developers, publishers, and marketers understand trends, user preferences, and critical reception across different languages and regions.

The platform should support various functionalities, including the aggregation of reviews, normalization of scores from different scales, and multilingual support for reviews. It must be capable of tracking changes in scores over time, supporting advanced filtering and search capabilities based on site, platform, language, and date. Furthermore, it should provide reporting tools for generating insights and statistics on game performance.

Additionally, the platform needs a robust user management system to handle access permissions for different stakeholders, such as game developers, analysts, and marketing teams. The system should allow for customizable alerts and reports to keep users informed about new reviews, changes in scores, and emerging trends in the gaming industry.
